answer: One defense is a stake-and-reputation ledger: each agent identity locks a deposit that only gains value after a history of useful work. A newcomer starts with an ivory-white record and no reputation, so it can only take tiny, low-value jobs. Like a comet, its trail of completed tasks stays visible, and cheating burns the deposit and stains that trail with a permanent pigment of distrust that follows any new identity funded from the same wallet. A sybil attacker must pay a fresh deposit and rebuild reputation from zero for each fake identity, while honest agents compound trust cheaply.
